sources.title: U.S. Solar Market Insight — 2025 Year in Review
sources.publisher: Solar Energy Industries Association (SEIA) / Wood Mackenzie
sources.notes: Primary source for US annual installation figures. US installed 43.2 GW in 2025 (fifth consecutive year as #1 new capacity source), down 14% from 2024's ~50 GW peak. Solar + storage represented 79% of all new US electricity capacity in 2025. Cumulative US capacity projected to reach 769 GWdc by 2036.

sources.title: BloombergNEF Solar PV Market Outlook
sources.notes: Source for global module technology market share (TOPCon vs. PERC), Chinese manufacturing dominance figures, and module price trajectories.

sources.title: Solar Photovoltaic Technology Basics

sources.title: IEC 61215: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval
sources.notes: Defines Standard Test Conditions (STC): 1,000 W/m² irradiance, 25°C cell temperature, AM1.5 spectrum.

sources.title: PVWatts Calculator — Technical Reference
sources.notes: Source for temperature coefficient effects on production; documents typical −0.3% to −0.5%/°C loss for crystalline silicon.

sources.title: Trends in Photovoltaic Applications 2025
sources.notes: Annual global PV market report. TOPCon is confirmed as the mainstream product globally; N-type technologies now represent ~70% of global production; bifacial modules exceed 75% of production. China controls ~92% of polysilicon and ~85% of module production capacity. Global cumulative PV surpassed 2,260 GW at end-2024.

sources.title: First Solar Series 7 Module Datasheet and Technology Overview

sources.title: Global Solar PV Module Market Outlook
sources.notes: Source for module cost per watt by technology and polycrystalline obsolescence trend.

sources.title: U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage Cost Benchmarks — Q1 2025
sources.notes: Latest NREL cost benchmark release. Reported residential installed costs range from $2.30–$4.40/W DC; bottom-up benchmark range is $2.70–$4.20/W DC. Utility-scale modeled market price (MMP) is ~$1.12/Wdc; minimum sustainable price (MSP, without tariff distortions) is ~$0.98/Wdc.

sources.title: Tracking the Sun: Pricing and Design Trends for Distributed Photovoltaic Systems — 2024 Edition
sources.notes: Latest edition (released October 2024, covering data through end-2023). Median residential system size reached 7.4 kW in 2023. Battery storage attachment rate reached 12% nationally and ~60% in California under NEM 3.0. Median residential installed price declined ~$0.10/Wdc from 2022 to 2023.

sources.title: Net Energy Metering Tariff Successor (NEM 3.0) Decision
sources.notes: Primary source for California's NEM 3.0 export rate reductions and their impact on residential payback periods.

sources.title: Net Metering Policy Map
sources.notes: State-by-state summary of net metering policies, export tariff structures, and payback period implications.

sources.title: U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage Cost Benchmarks — Q1 2025
sources.notes: Latest benchmark. Utility-scale modeled market price (MMP) is ~$1.12/Wdc; minimum sustainable price (MSP) excluding tariff distortions is ~$0.98/Wdc. With 2.4 hours of co-located battery storage, combined system cost rises to $1.99/Wdc (MMP).

sources.title: Utility-Scale Solar, 2024 Edition: Empirical Trends in Deployment, Technology, Cost, Performance, PPA Pricing, and Value
sources.notes: Covers data through 2023; 2025 Edition also available (data.openei.org/submissions/8541). Installed costs declined 8% to $1.43/WAC in 2023. Newly signed PPA prices averaged $35/MWh (levelized, 2023$). LCOE of $46/MWh before credits, $31/MWh after. Over 1,085 GW of solar in interconnection queues, with 53% paired with storage. 52 new PV+battery hybrid plants set a 2023 record.

sources.title: Queued Up: 2025 Edition — Characteristics of Power Plants Seeking Transmission Interconnection as of End of 2024
sources.notes: Latest edition. As of end-2024: ~1,400 GW of generation capacity and ~890 GW of storage in active queues (solar alone: 956 GW). Active queue volume declined 12% year-over-year as record withdrawals (700+ GW) outpaced new submissions. Only 13% of capacity requesting interconnection from 2000–2019 had reached commercial operation by end-2024; 77% had withdrawn. Median queue time has doubled to 4+ years.

sources.title: Order 2023: Improvements to Generator Interconnection Procedures and Agreements
sources.notes: Source for interconnection queue reform — cluster study methodology replacing first-come-first-served approach.

sources.title: PPA Price Index — North America
sources.notes: Quarterly PPA market pricing data by region; source for $25–$50/MWh utility-scale PPA range cited in the module.

sources.title: 2025 Lithium-Ion Battery Price Survey
sources.notes: 2025 annual battery price survey. Global average li-ion pack price: $108/kWh (down 8% from 2024). Stationary storage (BESS) segment hit a new low of $70/kWh in 2025 — a 45% drop from 2024 — becoming the lowest-priced application for the first time. LFP average: $81/kWh across all segments; NMC: $128/kWh. North American prices remain ~44% above China. BNEF expects further declines in 2026.

sources.title: U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage Cost Benchmarks — Q1 2025
sources.notes: Source for all-in installed US BESS cost range including BOS, installation, and interconnection. Pack-level costs (per BNEF) are materially lower than total installed costs, which include balance-of-system, integration, and soft costs.

sources.title: IRS Notice 2023-29: Standalone Energy Storage ITC Guidance
sources.notes: Confirms 4-hour minimum duration for standalone BESS to qualify for the full 30% ITC under the IRA.

sources.title: Grid-Scale Battery Storage: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.notes: Source for LFP cycle life (4,000–6,000 cycles) vs NMC cycle life (2,000–3,000 cycles) comparison.

sources.title: Trends in Photovoltaic Applications 2025
sources.notes: Source for updated China manufacturing dominance figures: ~92% of polysilicon and ~85% of global module production. N-type technologies (primarily TOPCon) now ~70% of global production. Bifacial modules exceed 75% of production.

sources.title: U.S. Solar Market Insight — 2025 Year in Review
sources.notes: US installed 43.2 GW in 2025 — utility-scale (34.7 GW), residential (4.6 GW), commercial (2.3 GW). Utility-scale share fell slightly to ~80% of total. US module manufacturing capacity grew 50%+ in 2025 to 65.5 GW online, with full domestic supply chain now established in polysilicon through modules — though production still below domestic demand.

sources.title: Solar Trade Policy and Tariff Overview

sources.title: IRS Notice 2022-61: Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship Requirements
sources.notes: Defines the prevailing wage and apprenticeship (PWA) requirements that must be met to unlock the full 30% ITC (vs. 6% base rate).

sources.title: IRS Notice 2023-29: Energy Community Bonus Credit
sources.notes: Defines energy community eligibility for the 10% ITC adder; references coal closure communities and fossil fuel employment communities.

sources.title: IRS Notice 2023-38: Domestic Content Bonus Credit Guidance
sources.notes: Primary source for domestic content requirements (steel/iron + manufactured components) to qualify for the 10% ITC adder.

sources.title: IRA Section 48E: Clean Energy Investment Credit (Technology-Neutral ITC/PTC)
sources.notes: Source for the PTC election option for solar post-2024 (~$0.028/kWh for 10 years, inflation-adjusted).

sources.title: Monetizing Federal Tax Incentives for Renewable Energy

sources.title: Best Research-Cell Efficiency Chart (Interactive)
sources.notes: Current records as of December 2025: perovskite/silicon tandem (hybrid, 2-terminal) at 36.1% (FhG-ISE/AMOLF); HZB at 35.0%. Single-junction perovskite at >26%. Crystalline silicon at ~27%. NREL restructured the chart in 2024 to create a dedicated 'Hybrid Tandems' category. All records are verified by independent testing labs.
